title: Glooscap Campground & RV

services.name: Glooscap Campground
services.desc: The Glooscap Campground will open for the 2026 season on May 15th and close on Oct. 12thBookings for the 2026 season are now open. Located in Parrsboro, Nova Scotia, the Glooscap Campground & RV offers:- 39 seasonal RV sites with 2-way service (water and power)- 14 unserviced tenting sites- 8 sites with 20-amp service- 16 sites with 30-amp service (5 are pull-through) Management reserves the right to refuse admission or ask any party to leave if campground rules are not followed. There is zero tolerance for theft or vandalism. - Speed limit: 15 km/h within the campground. ATVs and dirt bikes are not permitted.- Site occupancy: One family and two cars maximum per site. Double tenting
